description: Follow-up to irl-subt-cde: picking a key-blocked cloud option in a role's dropdown opens a key field in place instead of being unselectable, and every service gets a 'How do I get a key?' sheet with the signup click-path, console URL, what it costs to start, and a caveat. Verified signup paths and free tiers live on 2026-09-16.
title: Cloud summary keys: in-place entry and a how-to-get-a-key modal per service
